name: 21787 · Taneytown, MD
findings: ZIP 21787 (Taneytown) has 25 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (68%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 13 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 21787 (Taneytown) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 21787 (Taneytown) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).
